text:
INT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

HERO and VILLAIN face each other.

HERO
In a world where only you can stop this, trust your instinct.

VILLAIN
This changes everything. You just don't get it.

HERO
We need to talk. Are you okay? I'm sorry.

VILLAIN
Raise the stakes. It was all a dream unless you love me.

HERO
I love you.
I can't do this anymore.
What do you mean?
